review.scope: Directed BACKEND_API OWASP-oriented closure review inherited from N8.11.A preflight and completed against the current Desarrollo functional candidate.
verifiedControls: JWT bearer validation enforces issuer, audience, lifetime and signing key; authorization policies protect sensitive API surfaces.
Login is anonymous by design and bounded by a fixed-window rate limiter keyed by the effective remote IP; failed and successful login events are audited.
ForwardedHeaders processing is explicit and bounded to one forwarded hop; the directed contract suite covers the intended source-IP/rate-limit path without weakening production controls.

Public Tienda routes are intentionally anonymous and rate limited; inbound webhook is anonymous only by protocol necessity and fails closed on HMAC signature validation with replay/idempotency and request-size controls.
Sensitive tenant/admin/payment routes require authorization and preserve tenant/company scope; provider-facing failures are sanitized before API exposure.
Bulk upload/import endpoints enforce permission, extension/content/size bounds and generic error responses; request body/form limits are configured globally.
Repository configuration uses placeholders rather than deploy credentials; no committed secret value was required or exposed by this review.
Directed API security contract tests were added and corrected in the functional implementation commits and are included in the full backend solution test gate.
